verdict.rationale: CDP supports fiat-to-stablecoin and stablecoin-to-fiat movement (Onramp/Offramp, auto-conversion of USDC to USD, treasury payouts) and trading between tokens on Base, but the docs don't expose a dedicated quote API with documented rates/fees/settlement times as a distinct first-class conversion primitive — conversion is folded into onramp/offramp and trade skills rather than presented as an explicit quote+execute conversion endpoint. missing for 10: explicit quote endpoint returning rate/fee/settlement-time before execution, documented fee schedules, documented settlement-time SLAs for conversions, and independent confirmation these are accurate/reliable.
